newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash grains, oils tumble with Chicago.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash grains, oils tumble with Chicago.

text.p: Argentine cash grains and oilseeds took a tumble Monday on the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange in the wake of losses in Chicago under pressure from weekend rains in the U.S. Midwest, dealers said.
"The market was disoriented and there was little selling going on," said one dealer.
Soybeans and maize reflected Chicago's losses to close $3 per tonne weaker, dragging down sunseed about $2. Spot wheat fell $3-4 a tonne and wheat new crop was $1 weaker.
